prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a hand delicately pruning a thin, leafless branch with a pair of black garden shears. The focus is on the intersection of the shears and the branch, with the hand partially visible at the bottom of the frame, suggesting careful, intentional movement. Scattered among the twigs are a few vibrant, translucent red-orange leaves, their color glowing warmly against a softly blurred background of lush green foliage. The lighting is natural and diffused, creating gentle highlights on the leaves and subtle shadows on the hand and branches, evoking a serene, contemplative mood. The depth of field is shallow, drawing attention to the crisp details of the shears, leaves, and hand, while the background melts into a soft bokeh. The overall style is intimate and organic, reminiscent of a nature documentary or a poetic arthouse film, with a harmonious, earthy color palette dominated by greens, browns, and the striking red of the leaves.
